question: Will the Official Loch Ness Monster Sightings Register report a sighting for November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Two summaries of the resolution page (I could not download the raw page) show zero November sightings in 2021-2025, and zero December sightings too. Older Novembers (2001, 2014, 2017, one more) show they happen occasionally. 2026 is an unusually active year (15 entries vs 3-10 per year in 2021-2025), which pushes up, but entries cluster March-August; the last is 21 Aug 2026, with none in Sep-Oct. A failure to update resolves No. No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- Resolution page lochnesssightings.com/sightings-from-2021-on (fetched 2026-10-29) lists 2026 entries: 12 Jan; 1 Mar; 21, 23, 25 Apr; 18 May; 23 Jun; 5, 21, 23, 25, 27 Jul; 5, 6, 21 Aug. The latest entry is 21 Aug 2026; no Sep or Oct 2026 entries were listed as of 29 Oct.
- Yearly totals on that page (from the fetch tool's summary): 2021: 6; 2022: 6; 2023: 10; 2024: 3 (4 Apr, 27 Sep, 9 Oct); 2025: 6 (22 Mar, 23 May, 29 Aug, 12/15/28 Oct).
- The fetch tool reported zero November and zero December entries for 2021-2025 (a summary, not verified against the raw page).
- Dexerto (early 2026): the register went about 6 months without an entry, late Oct 2025 through end of Feb 2026 (this conflicts with the 12 Jan 2026 entry now listed, which suggests some entries are added late).
- Older November sightings exist on the register's archive pages: 21 Nov 2001, 6 Nov 2014, 2 Nov 2017, plus one 22 Nov (year unclear). Winter sightings happen, but rarely.
- Since 2021 the register records webcam images separately (17 to date); it is unclear whether webcam entries count on the resolution page.
- 2026 is an unusually active year (15 entries vs 3-10 per year in 2021-2025), concentrated Apr-Aug in tourist season.
- Resolves off the resolution page as first checked by Metaculus on or after 2026-12-15. A failure to update or the site going offline resolves No.
- Event window: 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-30 per the criteria; as of 2026-10-29, 0% elapsed. The page must show the entry by about 15 Dec (roughly 2 weeks' lag allowed).
- Searched for human markets (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi, bookmakers): none found.
- Status quo: no November entry in any recent year.
calls.reference_class: November months in the Official Loch Ness Sightings Register, 2021-2025 (with older years as a check)

calls.reasoning: Base rate: 3 of the last 16 years (2010-2025) had a November sighting on the register (2014, 2017, 2020); none in 2021-2025. 2026 is a busy year (15 sightings), like 2017-2020, when 2 of 4 years had a November entry, which pushes up. Pushing down: the register shows no entries after 21 Aug 2026, sightings cluster in spring to October, and resolution needs the register to show the entry by 15 Dec. No human market found (none on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi; no bookmaker line).

- Resolves off the register page lochnesssightings.com/sightings-from-2021-on, checked on or after 2026-12-15. It needs a sighting dated November 2026 shown there. Failure to update or the site going offline resolves NO.
- Event window: 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-30 (sighting date), and the entry must be visible by the check on or after 2026-12-15. As of 2026-10-29 none of the event window has elapsed.
- Register page fetched 2026-10-29: 15 sightings dated in 2026 (Jan 12; Mar 1; Apr 21, 23, 25; May 18; Jun 23; Jul 5, 21, 23, 25, 27; Aug 5, 6, 21). Nothing dated September or October 2026 is listed.
- News 2026-10-27 (1045wjjk.com): 2026 total 15, more than double 2025's 6. Consistent with no new entries since August.
- Yearly counts from the register: 2021: 6; 2022: 6; 2023: 10; 2024: 3; 2025: 6; 2026 so far: 15. 2010-2020: 1, 5, 2, 1, 7, 8, 7, 15, 15, 18, 13.
- November sightings on the register: 2014 (Nov 6), 2017 (Nov 2), 2020 (Nov 15, Nov 24). None in 2010-2013, 2015-2016, 2018-2019, or 2021-2025.
- Rate over all years 2010-2025: 3 of 16 years had a November sighting. Rate over high-activity years (13+ sightings: 2017-2020): 2 of 4. Rate over years with 10 or fewer sightings: 1 of 12 (2014).
- Sightings cluster from spring to October. 2021-2025 latest-dated entries in October each year (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025); none in Nov or Dec.
- The register includes webcam sightings (e.g. a prolific webcam watcher was reported making the first webcam sighting of 2026, per brobible).
- Searched for: November 2026 sightings news (none yet; the window hasn't opened), and prediction markets on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi and bookmakers (none found).
- Couldn't verify the typical delay between a sighting and its register entry. Past news items suggest days to a few weeks.
calls.reference_class: Years 2010-2025 on the Official Loch Ness Sightings Register: did November have at least one listed sighting?

calls.reasoning: Register pages 2000-2020 show November sightings only in 2001, 2014 and 2020; the 2021+ page shows none in November 2021-2025, so about 3 of 26 Novembers (~12%). Sightings cluster March-October. 2026 is an unusually active year (~15 register sightings, more than double 2025's 6), which pushes the odds up modestly. But November is off-season, the latest register entry is 21 Aug 2026 (none yet for Sep/Oct), and a late-November sighting not posted by Dec 15 would not count. No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- Resolution: resolves off the lochnesssightings.com 'sightings-from-2021-on' page showing a sighting dated November 2026, first checked on or after 2026-12-15. A site failure or non-update resolves No.
- Event window: 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-30 (the sighting date), and it must be posted by about 2026-12-15. As of 2026-10-29 none of the window has elapsed.
- Register 2021+ page (fetched 2026-10-29): 2021 sightings were June-Aug (6); 2022 Mar-Oct (6, last 11 Oct); 2023 Apr-Oct (10, last 21 Oct); 2024 Apr, 27 Sep, 9 Oct (3); 2025 Mar, May, Aug, plus 12/15/28 Oct (6). No November or December sightings 2021-2025.
- 2026 entries so far: 12 Jan, 1 Mar, 23 & 25 Apr, 18 May, 23 Jun, five in July, 5/6/21 Aug. Latest entry shown is 21 Aug 2026; none for Sep/Oct 2026 appeared on the fetch.
- Register 2000-2020 page: November sightings 21 Nov 2001, 6 Nov 2014, 15 & 24 Nov 2020; December sightings 13 & 19 Dec 2018. So 3 of 21 Novembers in 2000-2020 had a sighting.
- Base rate over all Novembers 2000-2025: 3/26 ≈ 12%. Over 2021-2025 only: 0/5.
- 2026 volume is high: ~15 sightings per a 27 Oct 2026 news article (1045wjjk), versus 6 in 2025. The Inverness Courier reported the 2026 count at 13 at an earlier date. Webcam sightings are included in the register.
- Media attention in late Oct 2026: a Times report (25 Oct) on MoD files, and a new Adrian Shine book (20 Oct).
- Posting lag: unknown. Media articles typically appear within days to weeks of a sighting. The absence of Sep/Oct 2026 entries could mean a lag or simply no sightings.
- Markets: none found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.
- Searched but not found: the register's typical posting lag; any Sep/Oct 2026 sighting reports.
calls.reference_class: Calendar Novembers 2000-2025 in the Official Loch Ness Monster Sightings Register containing at least one sighting

calls.reasoning: About 3-4 of 26 Novembers since 2000 (2001, 2014, maybe 2017, 2020) had a register sighting, and none in 2021-2025, so the base rate is about 12-15%. 2026 is a busy year (15 entries), like 2017-2020, which pushes up modestly. But nothing has been listed since 21 Aug, November is off-season, and the entry must be posted by the 15 Dec check (failure to update resolves No). Net about 15%. No human market found.
calls.reconciliation: The main factual dispute is which past Novembers had sightings: 2017 is in runs 1-2 but not 3, 2020 is in runs 2-3 but not 1, and 2001 is in runs 1 and 3 only. Without web access this can't be settled, so I took the union, giving about 3-4 of 26 years (12-15%); all runs agree on 0 in 2021-2025. The judgment dispute is how much the busy 2026 should count. Comparing with 2017-2020 (2 of 4 years had a November entry) gives a moderate increase, but the empty Sep/Oct and the posting-lag risk offset much of it. I land at 0.15.

disagreements.verdict: Unresolved without web access; took the union, about 3-4/26, which changes the base rate only slightly

disagreements.verdict: Modest upward weight only, because no entries are listed after 21 Aug
